sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Blank-Check Entity for Public Market Acquisition Mergers (SPAC)

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: EU-United States FTA framework (ongoing negotiated commitments)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: French Monetary and Financial Code (Code monétaire et financier), Articles L. 561-1 et seq. and R. 561-1 et seq.; Article L. 561-45 to L. 561-54 (UBO register); Décret n° 2017-1094 du 9 juin 2017; AMF General Regulation and AMF Position-Recommendation DOC-2018-07; EU AML Directives 2015/849 and 2018/843 as transposed.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of passport or national ID for each individual UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary competent in the UBO's country of nationality or residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (competent authority of the issuing state); Consular Legalization for non-HCCH jurisdictions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / corporate extract for any corporate UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National Business Registry of the corporate UBO's country of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization as applicable

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address for each UBO (utility bill or bank statement)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or regulated bank in the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Hague Apostille / Consular Legalization where required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Sworn statement of beneficial ownership (attestation sur l'honneur)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: French notary or the RCS greffe for the new French SAS
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: No apostille required when issued in France; must be in French or accompanied by sworn translation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory automated screening of all UBOs, directors, and shareholders against the French Tracfin list, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UN Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List, and national PEP databases prior to registration and on an ongoing risk-based basis; enhanced due diligence for PEPs, senior foreign officials, and high-risk third-country ties.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Infogreffe – Registre National du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) / Guichet Entreprises (guichet-entreprises.fr)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory name must be in French or transliterated into Latin characters; non-French corporate expressions are permitted only if translated or approved; the name must not be contrary to public order, misleading as to the purpose, or include terms reserved for licensed activities.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: In the event of name rejection by the Greffier of the Tribunal de Commerce or the INPI, the applicant may file a written appeal (requête) to the President of the competent Tribunal Judiciaire within 30 days of receipt of the rejection, attaching a formal written explanation of the intended use, supporting use-of-name evidence, and alternative names; a qualified French attorney should sign the filing.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is not acceptable as the sole registered office for a SAS intended to operate as a SPAC; AMF licensing and commercial-substance rules require a real French administrative head-office address, with ancillary virtual-address services limited to supplementary mail handling and meeting space.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company name clearance and RCS availability search at Infogreffe/INPI
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Infogreffe / Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of French SAS articles of association (statuts) and UBO declaration
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for international SAS incorporation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: RCS incorporation filing fee and registration duties
Notarization and apostille/consular legalization of UBO identity and corporate documents (estimated 4 documents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary, Foreign Ministry/Apostille authority, French consulate as applicable

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP and sanctions screening tool subscription and execution for all UBOs and directors
Registered office address service (administrative head-office address for 12 months)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registered office service provider in France

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-filing consultation with AMF/ACPR adviser regarding SPAC licensing status and public trust-escrow account
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French regulatory law firm or AMF-registered adviser
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for regulated Fintech/SPAC advisory

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Opening internal trust/escrow account order (Swift wire and custody) for SPAC subscription proceeds

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Book II, Title II – Articles L.227-1 to L.227-20 on the Société par Actions Simplifiée (SAS); common commercial company rules Articles L.210-1 to L.210-10, L.211-1 to L.211-12, L.224-1 et seq.; implementing rules R.227-1-1 et seq.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), maintained by the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce; filings are made electronically through the INPI Guichet Unique (formalites.inpi.fr).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Déclaration de constitution de société (M0 – Cerfa no. 14448*01) and the signed Articles of Association (Statuts), transmitted to the RCS through the Guichet Unique.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: By-law determines the capital (no statutory minimum under L.227-1). Cash contributions are subscribed in full; at constitution, the shareholders must release the amount required by the by-laws (commonly 50% of the nominal value) into a blocked deposit account at a French bank or notary. For SPAC operations, the subscription trust/escrow account must remain segregated under AMF guidelines; the bank release is instructed only upon delivery of the RCS Kbis.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: UNDER THE FRENCH CODE DE COMMERCE, THE FOUNDING SHAREHOLDER(S) UNANIMOUSLY RESOLVE AS FOLLOWS: 1. The Articles of Association are adopted; the entire share capital of EUR [ ] is subscribed and effected in compliance with statutory capital-deposit requirements. 2. The registered office shall be fixed at [ ] in Paris, France, from the RCS filing date. 3. [Name / legal entity] is appointed President of the SAS, with power to act under the company name for all purposes, to sign all incorporation documents, and to initiate the SPAC project. 4. The President is authorized to open an operational account and a blocked trust/escrow account to hold acquisition funds. 5. This resolution shall be effective as of this date. The President is directed to file for registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft and lawfully sign the Articles of Association / by-laws
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Any attorney (avocat) or self-drafted; notarization required only for contributions of real estate or shared assets.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the SAS Articles of Association containing the SPAC corporate purpose, share classes and governance; verify ISIC 6499 blank-check activity, anti-money-laundering policies, and the prohibition on public capital offers unless converting to SA at listing. Have each founding shareholder sign all pages and the last page separately; if the president is not yet appointed, the first resolution appoints him.
required_dossiers: Certified passport of all ultimate beneficial owners
SPAC acquisition mandate or business plan
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If statutory compliance is challenged, amend restrictive clauses by private unanimous decision before filing; for real estate contributions, submit notarized deed to the notary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open blocked escrow account and pay up subscribed capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French credit institution or notary holding a blocked account (compte bloqué) opened in the future company's name, or Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a non-bearing blocked account in the name of the future SAS. Transfer each cash subscription directly to the account. Request the bank's attestation of blocked funds (attestation de dépôt des fonds) containing subscriber names, amounts and expiry. Keep the funds frozen until the registrar has issued the Kbis.
required_dossiers: Source of funds and SPAC financing statement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects data due to missing AML information, supplement the beneficial owner statement or select another accredited bank; unblock and re-deposit if resolution discrepancies arise.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publish the legal notice in an authorized legal announcements newspaper (JAL)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Journal d'Annonces Légales (JAL) authorized for the department of the registered office (e.g. Petites Affiches, Les Échos).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare a notice in French containing the corporate name, short form (SAS), capital, registered office, corporate object, duration, and the registry where application will be made. Place the advertisement in an approved legal-notices newspaper within the department of the registered office; obtain the certificate of publication (certificat de parution).
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the JAL refuses due to missing information, obtain a corrected wording and reprint; in case of error in publication, place a corrective announcement within 15 days without additional legal action.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File M0 and annexes with the Guichet Unique for RCS registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet Unique (formalites.inpi.fr), acting on behalf of the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce and the RCS.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Create an account; select the form 'Société par actions simplifiée' and 'immatriculation'; complete the M0 declaration with the company name, object, registered office, and share details; attach the signed Statuts and all supporting documents in PDF; attest to the accuracy of declarations; pay the official registry fee; submit. After submission, the greffier verifies the file and may issue a desiderata.
required_dossiers: Attestation de dépôt des fonds from the bank
Lease / domiciliation contract / ownership deed for registered office
Identity document of the appointed President
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Within 15 days of a query, use the Guichet Unique desiderata workflow; add the missing proof, correct the M0, and sign the attestation. If the file is rejected, appeal to the President of the Commercial Court within 30 days or reapply after curing the inconsistency.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain RCS extract (Kbis) and SIREN/SIRET registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce via Infogreffe; INSEE assigns SIREN/SIRET and APE/NAF code.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After registration, the greffier publishes the creation at the RCS and reports to INSEE. Download the official extract Kbis from Infogreffe; check legal data, registered address, officers, legal form, and the code APE/NAF; verify that the ISIC 6499 activity is accurately reflected, and request a rectification if the assigned code is inconsistent.
required_dossiers: No additional filing; use RCS registration identifier
Power of attorney for Kbis issue if requested
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If Kbis has not been delivered within 10 days, write to the RCS greffe via Infogreffe. If SIREN/SIRET or APE/NAF coding is inconsistent with ISIC 6499, request an INSEE rectificatif through the Guichet.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-incorporation governance records and preliminary SPAC review
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Corporate legal counsel in coordination with the Autorité des Marchés Financiers (AMF) for SPAC prospectus and public listing preparation.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Set up the corporate records: share register, minutes book, and decision records; adopt an internal regulation (règlement intérieur) for the SPAC; register the operational office; confirm insurance and appoint a compliance officer. If a public offering is planned, submit the draft prospectus to the AMF for preliminary review and ensure the escrow trust restrictions are documented.
required_dossiers: Conflicts of interest and confidentiality policy
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the AMF preliminary review requests amendments, respond to the issuer file within 30 days; for governance gaps, adopt new resolutions by the board and record them in the minutes.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Autorité des Marchés Financiers (AMF) – Issuer Directorate and Enforcement Directorate; parallel notification to the Direction Générale du Trésor when the SPAC reaches public-offering thresholds.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: AMF visa on the prospectus and establishment authorization as a special-purpose acquisition company (SPAC) for public market acquisition transactions.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: DREAL / Ministère de la Transition écologique de la République française
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from full EIA at the pure-administrative incorporation stage; a full or scoped EIA is triggered only if post-acquisition target activities become installations classified as ICPE.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: For the SPAC administrative office: zero process wastewater, compliance with municipal wastewater discharge limits, and waste sorting obligations under Article L.541-2 of the Environmental Code. Once a target asset is acquired, the consolidated group must comply with EU Industrial Emissions Directive limits and national pollution norms, including VOC and combustion emission values.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: For the registered office: fire safety certification and inspection for ERP class 5, maintenance of fire extinguishers, and occupational risk assessment (DUERP) under Articles L.4121-2 et seq. of the Labour Code. No industrial civil-defense clearance is required unless the SPAC later acquires physical facilities subject to capacity or environmental permits.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) operating through the official French tax portal at https://www.impots.gouv.fr/
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: French SAS entities obtain statutory tax identification numbers (SIREN and SIRET) upon incorporation via the INSEE registry or the tax authority's guichet unique registration portal at impots.gouv.fr. Foreign entities establishing a French branch or subsidiary must submit incorporation documents, articles of association, and proof of legal existence to the same portal to procure the statutory TIN and intra-EU VAT identification number.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: France does not provide US-style check-the-box elections. Hybrid mismatch rules under the EU Anti-Tax Avoidance Directive (ATAD) apply, and specific entity classification considerations may arise in cross-border merger and acquisition contexts involving SPAC vehicles.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: 77,700 EUR (mandatory VAT registration threshold based on prior-year turnover; subject to annual indexation)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time e-invoicing regime (e-facturation) for all B2B transactions requiring transmission via the PEPPOL network with digital stamping, API integration for fiscal clearance, and automated reporting to the French tax authority; non-compliance triggers administrative penalties and potential blocking of payment accounts.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT rate applies to exports of goods outside the European Union provided the supplier furnishes proof of export and the goods are not re-imported into France or the EU. For offshore services, 0% VAT applies if the service is provided to a non-EU customer and the conditions of use are met outside France. SPAC listing vehicles must substantiate any export transactions with documentary evidence meeting French customs and VAT export rules.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Déclaration en Douane d'Exportation - DAU)
Bill of Lading or equivalent transport document (CMR)
Inward Remittance Certificate or proof of payment to non-EU recipient
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: French tax authorities conduct targeted post-export audits on zero-rating claims. Fraudulent or unsupported claims result in full retrospective clawback of zero-rated VAT, penalties up to 80% of the evaded amount, interest charges, and in cases of willful fraud, potential criminal prosecution under VAT fraud provisions.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Bank of France) as the central monetary authority; foreign-exchange control and balance-of-payments statistical oversight is exercised through the Direction Générale du Trésor (French Treasury) within the Ministry of the Economy and Finance, with prudential licensing and AML/CFT conduct supervision by the ACPR (Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution). Securities-market and SPAC-governance oversight is vested in the AMF (Autorité des Marchés Financiers). EUR clearing and settlement infrastructure operates under TARGET2 ownership administered by the Banque de France.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro is fully convertible across both current-account and capital-account transactions. France maintains a liberalised regime grounded in Articles 63-66 TFEU (free movement of capital) and the FRF 'décret 2019-153' foreign-investment screening framework, which applies only to strategic sectors (defence, dual-use, critical infrastructure). For a non-resident-owned SPAC, equity contributions, loan capital, dividend distributions, and redemption payments to public shareholders carry no convertibility restriction or prior exchange-control approval. Profit remittance and distribution of SPAC liquidation/redemption proceeds to non-resident investors are permitted, subject to standard beneficial-ownership (issued-capital, voting-rights, and 24-month holding) conditions of Directive 2011/96/EU for parent-subsidiary dividend withholding exemption. Practical hurdles include: (i) mandatory Banque de France statistical declaration for each cross-border funds transfer exceeding EUR 15,000 (or monthly net transfers) under the balance-of-payments reporting system (DÉBAR/COVADON); (ii) the bank's source-of-funds documentary verification for inbound capital from offshore investors; (iii) no segregated trust arrangement may repatriate funds to a foreign target account before AMF approval of the business-combination circular and release conditions of the escrow deed.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: France imposes no mandatory surrender, no compulsory conversion ratio, and no statutory time limit for realising export proceeds; exporting entities are free to retain, convert, or redeploy foreign-currency receipts. Obligations are purely statistical and transactional: resident legal entities must report to Banque de France any cross-border payment or receipt exceeding EUR 15,000 per transaction or any balanced netting position, including SPAC trust disbursement and placement inflows, under the DEBAR balance-of-payments regime. A SPAC engaged in no underlying trade exports is unaffected by export-proceeds rules; however, sponsor capital, underwriting proceeds, and acquisition continuation funds routed from non-resident investors are reportable credit-side entries, and the ordering bank performs the corrective/observational reporting on the entity's behalf without conversion requirement.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (compte séquestre) + EUR Operational Current Account (compte à vue) + USD dual-currency treasury line
Escrow/Trust Deposit Account + Corporate Operational Account + SWIFT-linked Transaction Banking facility
Escrow Trust Account + Multi-currency Treasury Account with cash-pooling capability
Escrow Account + Global SWIFT Settlement Account (GBP/USD/EUR)

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Mutuel / CIC (Banque CIC, Paris head office)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account + collection account for redemption payments

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low for SPAC escrow and trust functions; Medium for ancillary operational liquidity up to EUR 25,000. Digital Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs) such as Qonto, Shine, Revolut Business, and Wise Business may lawfully hold an operating account for a French SAS under a PSD2 (Directive (EU) 2015/2366) e-money licence registered with ACPR; however, French law (Articles L522-3 and L522-11-1 Code monétaire et financier) restricts the holding of third-party funds and escrow/segregated 'séquestre' services to licensed credit institutions. A SPAC's IPO proceeds, underwriting allocations, and trust-release mechanics therefore cannot be placed with an EMI; only the non-escrowed operational float may sit as e-money. Legal constraint: an EU-passported EMI (e.g., Irish or Luxembourgish license) may operate in France via freedom of services but must be ACPR-registered for local distribution; no passport allows an EMI to perform bank-guarantee or escrow functions. In practice the underwriting syndicate and AMF-required custodian will reject settlement via EMI rails.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Mandatory physical presence of at least one managing director (Président) or a formally authorised corporate officer (directeur général / directeur délégué) with board-ratified authority is required by all French Tier-1 onboarding compliance committees for a SPAC classified 'Medium_Risk_Enhanced'. Remote opening is technically permitted under Article L561-2 CMF identification rules through eIDAS-compliant qualified electronic signatures and notarised/certified corporate packs, but escrow activation and trust-account signatory mandates will trigger an in-person interview at a Paris branch of BNP/SG/Crédit Agricole CIB. Video-call KYC with certified identity verification (qualified trust service per eIDAS) is accepted only for the non-escrow operating account; the final sign-off for escrow signatories requires the natural-person director or an authorised proxy with a notarised power of attorney apostilled under the Hague Convention. AML policy additionally requires the legal representative to present the registered beneficial-owner certificate issued by the Tribunal de Commerce within the prior three-month period.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident sponsor opacity / failure to evidence ultimate beneficial ownership: French AML law (Article L561-5 CMF) compels the bank to identify the beneficiaire effectif; a blank-check vehicle with Cayman/Delaware/Luxembourg shareholders or a discretionary trust sponsor raises an automatic high-risk flag and potential refusal under Article L561-8-1.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Defense bundle: (1) certified corporate statutory documents (statuts) with full share register and all amendments; (2) Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs (RBE) filing certificate from the relevant Tribunal de Commerce; (3) individual KYC passports of each beneficial owner whose stake exceeds 25%, plus their professional track-record dossier; (4) 24-month sponsor-source-of-wealth statements validated by an external licensed auditor; (5) structured ownership chart with LEIs and jurisdictional tax-residence certificates; (6) executed underwriting and placement agency agreements; (7) copy of the AMF prospectus visa evidencing regulatory transparency.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: SPAC pre-deal / 'blind pool' structure without identified target: French internal banking policies treat undisclosed-target blank-check vehicles as a money-laundering red flag ('coquille vide' risk), potentially triggering SAR under Article L561-15 and suspension of the account.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Documentation to rebut the shell-company presumption: (a) injected substantive corporate substance evidence (lease of Paris office, three full-time executive professionals, minutes of board strategy meetings); (b) pre-commitment agreements or confidentiality agreements showing an active target pipeline; (c) sworn statement by the statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) confirming the escrow structure; (d) sponsorship commitment letter with express limitation that no investor proceeds may be paid to the sponsor before the business combination; (e) formal declaration from legal counsel certifying the SPAC does not facilitate fiscal fraud or evasion.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border SWIFT to third-country trust endpoints, trustee nominee accounts, or release of escrow during a quiet period: mismatch in the payment-chain counterparty versus the declared target and trustee triggers restrictive-measures screen hits (EU/OFAC/UK sanctions) and false positive on the Cayman trust or competing target shareholders.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Fully mapped trust and escrow flow-chart: (i) notarised escrow agreement designating the French credit institution as sole custodian; (ii) AMF-approved TERA (Trustee Escrow Release Agreement) with irrevocable release conditions; (iii) AMF no-objection letter covering post-approval closing windows; (iv) sanctions-screen clearance memos for the trustees, target-seller account holders, and redemption agent; (v) legal opinion from a French law firm on the enforceability of the release conditions under civil law 'séquestre' rules; (vi) chain of title certificates for each inbound placement wire showing the originator and final beneficial owner.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital for the SPAC must route as direct equity placement proceeds or sponsor margin loans through regulated bank rails only: (1) EUR-denominated wires via SWIFT MT103 (or SEPA CT where sender and receiver are within SEPA) using the purpose code 'Capital subscription / prise de participation' and the AMF prospectus visa reference in field 72; (2) placement proceeds from the underwriting syndicate are credited to the escrow trust account (compte séquestre) at the French custodian bank, never to the sponsor's private account; (3) for USD-denominated sponsor capital, conversion into EUR at the receiving correspondent bank is executed as a spot transaction, with the Banque de France DÉBAR declaration threshold (EUR 15,000) triggering automatic reporting by the operator; (4) a 'transparency letter' from the lead underwriter or placement agent is lodged at the bank, identifying the ultimate subscription amounts and investor categories; (5) the receiving bank verifies the LEI of the SPAC and the legal capacity of the signatory before posting; (6) any equity injection exceeding EUR 1,000,000 is flagged for enhanced due-diligence review and must be accompanied by the board resolution authorising issuance of additional shares in the SAS.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound clearing infrastructure is layered as follows: (a) primary acquisition consideration on closing: SWIFT MT103 customer credit transfer from the escrow release account to the target shareholders' accounts at their correspondent banks, executed only after (i) AMF visa/approval of the business-combination prospectus, (ii) shareholder/target approval resolutions, and (iii) trustee release certificate; (b) EU target consideration: SEPA Instant Credit Transfer (SCT Inst) or SEPA CT batch, with 'REMIT' or 'PURP' structured remittance code (e.g., ISAE1) where required; (c) deferred or earn-out consideration: transferable stand-by letters of credit (ISP98) or commercial letters of credit (UCP600) issued by the French bank in favour of target shareholders, payable against invoice-deed certificates; (d) public shareholder redemptions: SWIFT MT103 per redemption payment alongside formal capital-reduction notarisation, or through the Euroclear/CACEIS network for dematerialised share redemption settlement; (e) all outbound transactions are subject to Bank of France balance-of-payments declaration by the ordering institution when the individual remittance exceeds EUR 15,000 or when cumulative weekly transfers to a third-country jurisdiction exceed that amount; (f) escrowed funds may not be netted against sponsor receivables or invested outside the approved safe instruments (treasury bonds, money-market funds rated AAA) as specified in the escrow deed.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright EUR/USD forward foreign-exchange contracts for locking the acquisition consideration currency exposure, transacted under an executed ISDA/French-law master agreement with a MiFID II licensed counterparty and cleared through LCH Ltd or CME Europe where mandatory under EMIR

Non-deliverable forward (NDF) on emerging-market currencies (e.g., USD/BRL or USD/INR) for target-jurisdiction settlement exposure, cash-settled in EUR, permitted for hedging only and subject to the counterparty credit-limit and clearing threshold assessments of EMIR; no leverage on escrow assets

Cross-currency interest-rate swap (EUR/USD) converting the escrow investment yield or sponsor bridge-loan interest from a fixed EUR coupon to USD floating, permitted under EMIR clearing obligation when both counterparties are EU financial entities and the hedge is documented as risk-reducing under ESMA guidelines

FX option collar strategy (simultaneously purchased call and sold put options, or vice versa) executed physically or net-settled in EUR/USD, permissible where the premium budget is identified in the SPAC prospectus and the transaction does not introduce speculative open-FX exposure above the aggregate notional of the target acquisition consideration

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual statutory accounts filing (depot des comptes annuels) and management report with the RCS
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / Infogreffe; Registre du Commerce et des Societes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months of the fiscal-year end at the latest; when approved inside that period, deposit must occur within one month of approval. For a 31 December close, approval by 30 June and filing by 31 July unless extended by court order.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing amende forfaitaire currently approximately EUR 57, increased on formal notice; repeated failure may lead to court-ordered dissolution and administrative strike-off from the RCS.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: SME reduced rate 15% on first €42,500; R&D tax credit up to 50% of eligible expenses; innovation status benefits

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulaire 1200-A - Déclaration de résultat via impots.gouv.fr

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net turnover for the fiscal year
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only French-sourced income; non-residents file for French branch or permanent establishment
Adjust for French tax rules and deduct foreign losses if applicable
Apply reduced rate if SME; calculate on taxable profit

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Penalties of €500 to €10,000 for late filing; additional €50 per day up to €10,000; interest on late payments at 0.2% per month

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Submit TRC form with supporting documentation to invoke DTA reduced rates; approval required for non-resident recipients
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 0% to 10% per treaty; Interest: 0% to 10% per treaty; France-France treaties often 0% for both

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: €50 million turnover for local file; €750 million for master file
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: EU Economic Substance Regulations applicable; holding companies must demonstrate real economic activities in France

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate underreporting of income or false declarations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal penalties including fines up to 80% of evaded tax and imprisonment up to 5 years
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal criminal liability; possible imprisonment and restitution orders

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining entity without genuine business activities or economic purpose
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative sanctions including dissolution, fines up to €10,000, and potential criminal referral
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may face civil liability and disqualification from management

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using non-arm's length pricing without documentation or adjustments
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax reassessment plus penalties of 80% of understated tax plus interest
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Potential personal liability if willful misconduct

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to conduct due diligence or suspicious transaction reporting for acquisition vehicles
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to €1 million or 5% of turnover; criminal penalties
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Imprisonment up to 5 years and fines; possible travel bans
